title: Q6
description:
Read: Hag 2:6-9, Exo 19:16-18

He will shake heaven and earth, the desire of the nations will come, the later glory of the house will be greater, and in this place he will give peace. The earlier mountain already shook.

a) What does the later shaking carry that a bare threat of removal does not?

b) What is shaken is removed, so that what cannot be shaken remains. In that prophecy, what is the thing that remains?
